comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: The part I still find strange: one of these colonial lines was deliberately drawn to follow where Turkana herders moved their cattle in dry years. A border meant to shift with the rain can only be put on a map wrongly. Kenya has run the Ilemi Triangle for decades and does not call it disputed; South Sudan inherited Sudan's claim in 2011; nobody has ever jointly surveyed it. Sources are listed in the description. Is there a line near you that everyone treats as settled but nobody has actually measured?
